trap.label: would/used to/let
trap.wrong: When I was kid, I would to be afraid of dogs and my mom would let me to pet one.
trap.right: When I was a kid, I used to be afraid of dogs, and my mom would let me pet one.
trap.why: Em português “ficava com medo” e “deixava-me” exigem imperfeito. Em inglês, estado = used to; ação repetida = would; let sem to.

fix.wrong: I would be shy as a kid.
fix.right: I used to be shy as a kid.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com used to: “I was afraid of dogs.” (hábito antigo)
rewrite.answer: I used to be afraid of dogs.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com would: “We climbed the tree every day.”
rewrite.answer: We would climb the tree every day.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva sem to: “He made me to wait.”
